name: Presenton
description: Generates editable PPTX and PDF presentations from prompts, documents, or your own templates for teams and developers, via a self-hosted app, REST API, or MCP server.

skills.name: Presentation Generation
skills.description: Creates presentations from a prompt or uploaded documents, in Standard or Smart mode.

skills.name: Template from PowerPoint
skills.description: Turns an existing PowerPoint design and its fonts into a reusable presentation template.

skills.name: Custom Templates and Themes
skills.description: Builds presentation designs with HTML and Tailwind CSS.

skills.name: AI Slide Editing
skills.description: Edits the active slide or a selected element from a focused prompt to the built-in AI assistant.

skills.name: PPTX and PDF Export
skills.description: Exports fully editable PowerPoint (PPTX) and PDF decks.
